name: Oman
blurb: Fjords, wadis, forts and a gracious welcome.
cities: A grand mosque, a seafront corniche and Mutrah souq.
A fort, a souq and mountain villages nearby.
Ancient channels that still carry water to Oman's date-palm villages.
A medieval port visited by Ibn Battuta, with the domed tomb of Bibi Maryam.
Beehive-shaped Bronze Age tombs lined up along a rocky ridge.
A vast mud-brick fort and walled oasis town below the Jebel Akhdar.
